description: This Java class 'EntityRegionMap' provides an immutable, sharable map from resource types (Strings) to ActorRef instances, with functionalities to lookup, create singleton maps, and build customized maps via a builder pattern.

classes.name: EntityRegionMap
classes.description: Immutable class that maps resource types to ActorRef objects, providing lookup and equality operations.

classes.name: EntityRegionMap.Builder
classes.description: A builder class for constructing EntityRegionMap instances with multiple entries.

methods.name: lookup
methods.description: Retrieves an Optional ActorRef for the given resource type, if present.

methods.name: findRegion
methods.description: Private method to directly find the ActorRef associated with a resource type.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Function method to get the ActorRef for a resource type, nullable.

methods.name: singleton
methods.description: Creates an EntityRegionMap with a single resource type to ActorRef mapping.

methods.name: newBuilder
methods.description: Returns a new builder for creating an EntityRegionMap.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks for object equality based on the internal map.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Returns the hash code based on the internal map.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the EntityRegionMap.
